targets.authors: Jensen M., Kristiansen I., Sandbekk M., Kroger J.
targets.title: Ego identity status in cross-cultural context: A comparison of Norwegian and United States university students.
targets.evidence_quote: The purpose was to replicate research by Jensen, Kristiansen, Sandbekk, and Kroger. In that 1998 study, patterns of identity development were examined for late adolescents raised in the mixed liberal welfare-state economic system of Norway compared with late adolescents raised in the free-market economic system of the United States.
targets.outcome_quote: Present results were consistent with those of Jensen, et al., which found Norwegian students to score consistently lower on extent of exploration and of commitment than American students.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall agreement with the named original.

reasoning: New Norwegian sample re-tests the named published comparison. Full text unavailable: OA indexes had no copy; publisher PDF and ResearchGate were blocked. Abstract from Crossref, target citation from publisher landing page; no target DOI printed in available reference.
